verdict.rationale: Trello has a documented REST API (auth, batch, search, webhooks), so asking for a machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on developer.atlassian.com returned 404 on every path, though it did not check Trello-specific spec URLs, so confidence is medium rather than high.
